blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — INQUIRER.net data journalist Cristina Eloisa Baclig won third place in the Asia-Pacific category of the 2026 Global AMR Media Awards for her report on a newly identified bacterial species from Mayon Volcano in Albay that researchers say could contribute to future studies on antibiotic development. Baclig was the only finalist from the Philippines in the category. She placed behind Bangladesh-based journalist and visual reporter Zakir Hossain Chowdhury, who won first prize for the story “Antimicrobial Resistance Threatens Bangladesh’s Coasts,” and clinical reporter Laura Andronicos of The Medical Republic in Australia, who took second place for the story “Rising […]...
